exposure: Location of blood sample collection (uterine vein vs. peripheral vein)
Physiological state (pregnant/with placenta vs. postpartum/without placenta)
finding: The placenta is the main site of sFlt-1 production in normal pregnancies, as evidenced by a significant sFlt-1 gradient between uterine and peripheral veins and a significant drop in sFlt-1 levels after placental removal.
